resources.string: Lets a phone that you paired with M2 Smart Remote move focus, select items, go Back/Home, tap and scroll, and type into text fields on this projector. It acts only when a paired phone sends a command, and it does not read out or send screen content anywhere.

Security: the remote works only on your local network and only for phones you pair with this screen. Traffic is plain HTTP. Commands are signed so they cannot be forged or replayed, but someone on the same Wi-Fi could see which buttons you press. Use it only on a network you trust.
